objective: Reconcile all current Nov17/Nov18 owner-requested BUKLOD Android fixes into one staging-only, source-verified, fail-closed RC without overwriting current main, ads, media or formation reporting.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main SOURCE commit d23cd882f7d34c4bca3a110dadd04ee4cb2240a9 was read, and the current RC branch compared against it with zero missing commits; all required #916/#917/#923/#918/#922/#924 heads were independently compared as ancestors of the RC. This verifies repository SOURCE ancestry only, NOT the live production baseline. Historical Nov17 staging PR #900 recorded source 730c811cda97d106339f14fae04fb4b8890b0ed2 on runtime 1.3.2; no current device/OTA/runtime/fill has been physically verified by owner request.
chosenApproach: Create a single RC integration branch from latest main; merge source stacks #916-#917-#923 together, #918 Android instant tabs, #922 forward-port of #919 Henry translation, and #924 scoped video rendering, each against the same RC. Preserve component scope manifests and run consolidated exact-source CI, without automatic release.
selectionRationale: Dedicated RC branch avoids rewriting production/main, preserves formation migrations and source provenance, and isolates overlapping video/player changes. No new native dependencies, ads policy or backend writes. OTA promotion remains gated on immutable artifact and runtime compatibility.
preserveBehaviors: Current main/staging approved Wall and Connect compact spacing, avatar/full names, real recent comments, Marites swipe, privacy and photo recovery remain untouched
AdMob/IMA fill, consent, prewarming, first-view placement and offscreen lifecycle remain protected release blockers
Fullscreen clicked video, signed URL retry, low bandwidth cache and player handoff remain stable; new videos are append-only fair ranked
Cluster/Organization video posts respect RLS and private media permissions; reports and existing points/formation SQL not mutated
Bible's English Matthew Henry fallback remains available; ML Kit native support still requires a compatible APK, not just OTA
acceptanceChecks: Compare exact RC branch to main: only declared 31 paths; no dropped legacy fixes or formation migrations; include all six component scope manifests
Run changed focused tests and native-independent AdMob/nav/media source regression gates, TypeScript, web compatibility export and protected source tests
Preserve Android Hermes 1.3.2 compatibility and separate native ML Kit APK requirement; no native dependency/source changes
Do not publish staging/production until exact artifact & manifest verified through approved release path; actual device testing intentionally not claimed
Any failing ad load/fill, offscreen lifecycle, first-view ad warmup or navigation gate blocks OTA
alternativeApproaches: Merge each feature directly into production main (rejected because it risks unrelated incomplete DEV changes reaching production source)
Publish source without a reproducible RC and mandatory CI (rejected because ad/navigation/video regressions previously occurred)
Copy entire stale branch over latest main (rejected because this can drop Formation SQL, Wall edits and current media fixes)
